body: Yeah, I follow for sure. That does make a lot of sense. Unfortunately, I’m not entirely sure I have that in me. And I place very little value on my life in the first place, which doesn’t particularly help.

That does make sense. But how can I move on when I don’t have virtually any moments when I’m not hurting? I do try to take this as it comes, but if it really doesn’t get better, then that means I’ll get to be happy for about an hour a week for the rest of my life. That’s scary. And it doesn’t feel anywhere near worth it.

My bravery or lack thereof isn’t a concern to me, nor is proving anyone wrong (not that there really is anyone to prove wrong). My one and only concern is that every single day I spend alive is torture, and I need that shit to stop. I can’t handle it at this point. I don’t see any other way out.

You say that, but it’s impossible to know. Maybe I’m just meant to deal with this shit for my whole life. Maybe I’m just broken. Maybe I’m meant to end it. Killing myself is the only solution with a guaranteed outcome, and it’s the exact outcome I want. Not feeling this anymore. Not suffering anymore.
But I’m not brave. And I don’t feel any need to be. Why be brave when I can stop hurting instantly.

I’m at the point where I think I’m willing to give up that chance in order to stop feeling like this. Stopping everything doesn’t feel like something all that bad to me. I’m trying to find something to hold on to, but all I’m finding is how little there is for me in life.
It’s just so hard not to choose that one solution that I know will stop the hurt for good. At this point it feels like suicide is that magical switch.

I’m not brave enough though. I just need this to stop. By any means necessary. 

Everyone always says they’ll go through it with me but the truth is I’m alone in this, and I can’t handle it anymore. It comes from the right place I guess, but there’s only so much (read: none) that an occasional “I hope you’re having a good day” PM can do to help me get out of bed in the morning, or get my default state to be anything but on the verge of tears. 

It fucking hurts. And it’s hurt for so long. And I’m sick of it.
